verdict.rationale: Adyen documents API-only onboarding through the Legal Entity Management API and a hosted onboarding page where Adyen runs the flow and UI, with Adyen verifying users before payout. That covers the core of API-driven and hosted KYB/KYC onboarding. missing for 10: evidence of bank account linking, terms-of-service acceptance, embeddable onboarding components, explicit KYB vs KYC detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can onboard a seller through the API — KYB and KYC, bank account linking, and terms acceptance — with hosted flows and embeddable components when I don't want to build the forms

citations.quote: Build your own UI and collect required user data. You make API requests to create resources and submit the user data to Adyen.
Direct your users to a page hosted by Adyen, where Adyen manages the onboarding flow and user interface (UI).
To manage legal entities, use the Legal Entity Management API.
onboard sellers, service providers, or contractors on to your platform, and let Adyen verify them before paying out
